function: Over-the-air FL gradient aggregation (device pre-scalers, PS post-scaler) on single-antenna links: scalar Rayleigh channel h_{m,t} per device-PS link, no RIS; reason system, p. 3.
notes: Exclusion code 6 (system), shown on p. 3. Checks 1-5 pass: a research article that proposes and evaluates a method; FL over the air passes no_learning by rule; the OTA power control (device pre-scalers, PS post-scaler, truncated channel inversion) is physical-layer aggregation, so the work would be area 7 (its digital-FL half, TDMA with quantized uploads, is alone outside area 7). Code 6 applies because each device-PS link is single-antenna with no RIS. p. 3: 'We model the wireless channel between each device m in [N] and the PS as a Rayleigh flat block fading channel', with h_{m,t} ~ CN(0, Lambda_m) a scalar (p. 2: 'A boldface lowercase letter represents a vector'; h is not bold) that is inverted as x_{m,t} = (1/h_{m,t}) chi gamma_m g_{m,t} (eq. 4, p. 3). The words antenna, RIS and beamforming never appear, and MIMO appears only in the title of ref. [39]. The simulations (p. 8) place N in {10, 50} devices around one PS at fc = 2.4 GHz with no antenna count. Not an OTFS or NTN work. Identity: the PDF is arXiv 2503.06078v2 (14 Apr 2026, p. 1); the Crossref metadata of the DOI gives the same title and authors (Ul Abrar, Michelusi; IEEE TWC 2026), so the PDF is the paper of the DOI.
